card.name: Permanently after stop/discontinue
card.fires_on: The word "permanently" (or its ending "ently" in "Permanently") right after discontinue or stop treatment in dose-modification instructions. Weaker hits on other odd spots, like a number digit or "week".

modes.label: Permanently discontinue
modes.description: "Permanently" or the ending of "Permanently" in instructions to stop a drug for good.
modes.example: Discontinue YORVIPATH<< permanently>> in patients with a severe hypersensitivity reaction

modes.label: Split-word start
modes.description: The ending "ently" after "Perman" at the start of a sentence telling the reader to discontinue.
modes.example: Perman<<ently>> discontinue if pneumonitis is confirmed

modes.label: Scattered other hits
modes.description: Isolated words such as "week" in a fixed injection day or a name like "Defense" in a citation.
modes.example: It is advisable to determine an appropriate fixed day of the<< week>> for the injection.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the pattern.
